Strategic Regional Hub

Closer To Calmness. Away From Congestion.

Located at Udithyal, Balanagar-Shadnagar, immediately adjacent to the proposed Regional Ring Road (RRR) and just 5 minutes off Bangalore Highway NH 44. Experience tranquil holiday living with swift access to Hyderabad's southern economic corridors.

Transit & Expressways

  • NH 44 (Bangalore Highway) 5 Mins
  • Proposed Regional Ring Road Beside Site
  • Balanagar Junction 5 Mins
  • Shadnagar Town 15 Mins
  • RGA / Shamshabad Airport 40 Mins

Tech & Economic Giants

  • Rajapur SEZ 10 Mins
  • Shadnagar & Jadcherla SEZ 15 Mins
  • Microsoft Data Center 20 Mins
  • Adani Data Center 20 Mins
  • Symbiosis & Kanha Vanam 25 Mins
